verdict.rationale: Ente Auth documents sharing individual TOTP codes via temporary, end-to-end encrypted links with teammates (docs-16, docs-35), and explicitly restricts sharing to TOTP (not HOTP) entries (docs-30), which covers the core 'share TOTP logins with team' idea. However there is no evidence of a vault/collection construct or per-member access control (e.g., role-based permissions, group vaults, admin-managed membership) — sharing appears to be per-code link generation rather than an admin-managed shared vault. Missing for 10: evidence of collection/vault-based sharing, per-member access control or roles, and admin management console for team access.
